epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Visual regression error rate <= 0.1% against approved mockup
epics.tocConstraintRef: frontend/src/App.svelte layout and stylesheet styling fidelity
requirements: R1: Implement pixel-perfect layout and visual styling updates according to approved design mockup design/approved/20261117054021-mockup/mockup.html
R2: Ensure full responsiveness, accessible color contrast (WCAG AAA >= 7.0:1), and mobile viewport support in the existing web client

slices.title: Apply approved design mockup styling and layout to web interface
slices.jtbd: When implementing design updates for this epic, I want to apply the approved mockup layout and WCAG AAA color scheme to the existing frontend, so that the knowledge base interface matches the design specification with zero visual regressions.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved design reference design/approved/20261117054021-mockup/mockup.html,
When the frontend web interface is rendered on desktop and mobile viewports,
Then all typography, spacing, control parameters, and telemetry cards match the approved reference exactly.
Given an accessibility audit using WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast rules,
When assessing text elements and interactive controls against backgrounds,
Then contrast ratios achieve at least 7.0:1 across all updated views.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Layout pixel-delta variance < 2px across standard viewports
